netpolicy.title: Network policy
netpolicy.intro: Which of the assistant's services may reach the internet. Enforced in the device's own firewall, so a skill cannot go around it; localhost and your own network stay open.
netpolicy.now.title: Now
netpolicy.state.nft_failed: no: the firewall refused the rules
netpolicy.hint.speech: Speech recognition or the voice works on a server, so the device cannot go local only: it would neither hear nor speak. Choose on-device plugins under Voice and language.
netpolicy.hint.nflog: Refused connections cannot be read on this device, so they are only counted by the firewall, not shown here.
netpolicy.units.title: Services
netpolicy.refused.title: Refused
netpolicy.howto: The policy is in mycroft.conf under PHAL.admin.ovos-PHAL-plugin-netpolicy, or in /etc/ovos-netpolicy/policy.json when only root may change it. Say "go offline" or use the Privacy page to switch local only.
